# Subway Seat for fuzzel

Every color fuzzel has: the launcher on the raised paper ground with a quiet border, a text-wash selection, and matched letters in gold. The explicit `[main]` makes the include work at the end of the file too.

[fuzzel](https://codeberg.org/dnkl/fuzzel) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/fuzzel/) · Needs fuzzel 1.10+

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.ini`](subway-seat.ini) | `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat.ini` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.ini`](subway-seat-tunnel.ini) | `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-tunnel.ini` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.ini`](subway-seat-enamel.ini) | `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-enamel.ini` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/fuzzel/fuzzel.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat.ini
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/fuzzel/fuzzel.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-tunnel.ini
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/fuzzel/fuzzel.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-enamel.ini
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-tunnel.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/fuzzel/subway-seat-enamel.ini`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
